newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Louisville, Jefferson Cty Metro.

text.p: NOTICE OF BOND SALE
Louisville and Jefferson County Metropolitan Sewer District
(Commonwealth of Kentucky)

Sewer and Drainage System Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A The Louisville and Jefferson County Metropolitan Sewer District (the District''), hereby gives notice that the District will until the hour of 11:00 A.M., Eastern Time, on
Wednesday, February 26, 1997
receive in the office of Robert A. Miller, Director of Finance of the District, 700 West Liberty Street,

Louisville, Kentucky 40202, sealed competitive bids for the purchase of $51,325,000* aggregate principal amount of its Sewer and Drainage System Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A (collectively, the Bonds''). The Bonds are proposed to mature and to be subject to optional mandatory sinking fund redemption according to the provisions of the Official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement available from the Financial Advisor at the address set forth below. Proposals submitted for the
purchase of the Bonds are expected to be considered by the Board of the District, at a meeting currently expected to be held on February 27, 1997.
Bids must be on Official Bid Form contained in Information for Bidders available from the Financial Advisor, Banc One Capital Corporation, telephone (317) 321-1880 (contact

Robert M. Cramer or Tim Coolman) or telecopier (317) 321- 7672. Reference should be made to Official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale and Preliminary Official Statement for details and bidding conditions.
In order to assist bidders in complying with the

requirements of subsection (5) of Section (b) of Rule 15c2- 12 promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the District intends, for the benefit of the holders of the bonds, to execute a Continuing Disclosure Certificate dated as of the date of original issuance of the Bonds (the Continuing Disclosure Certificate''), setting forth the undertaking of the District to provide certain annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of this undertaking, including certain limitations thereon, is set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement and will also be set forth in the final Official Statement.
The right to reject bids or waive informality is reserved.
Delivery on or prior to March 12, 1997, is anticipated.
Louisville and Jefferson County
Metropolitan Sewer District
By /s/ Robert A. Miller
Director of Finance
*Estimated, subject to change as provided in Official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale.
(From The Bond Buyer)
